notes: IMPORTANT REFINEMENT to BLOCKER-MOVE-01's root-cause hypothesis: this was run as an extra differential specifically to test whether 'short/low-distinctiveness token' is the right characterization. 'AAA' is a short token too, yet ask parent's total=66 is plausible (there really are many real AAA-prefixed movers) and every one of the 8 displayed rows stays strictly AAA-prefixed/token-matched -- no unrelated company names leaked in, unlike the JK case. The more precise characterization: specialist-execution/v2 appears to fall back to a broad 'any company in this entity class' cohort match specifically when the strict name-match population for the requested name is SPARSE (few or no real candidates), rather than honestly reporting a small/empty candidate set the way move-ask-v1 does for the same sparse case. 'JK' triggers this because genuinely few companies contain that token; 'AAA' does not trigger it because genuinely many companies contain that token, so the broadening (if any occurs) is invisible in the top results. This should be handed to R1-018/Move-trust-Hub owners as the refined reproduction signal, not the original 'short token' framing.
